title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description: Guy Fieri is loading up on tropical flavor, starting in a Florida spot serving up lobster enchiladas and lionfish rolls. Then, in Hawaii, a funky food truck is cooking Vietnamese specialties like the bomb banh mi sandwiches and standout spring rolls.

title: Restaurant: Impossible
description: Daniel, a former NASA physicist in Huntsville, Ala., thought he could wing it in the restaurant business; after 10 years of failures, his soul food spot, Mizz Juju's, needs chef Robert Irvine's help to save the business and rebuild Daniel's life.

title: Restaurant: Impossible
description: Don, the owner of 7th Restaurant and Lounge in Charlotte, N.C., never asks for help despite becoming paralyzed after being robbed at gunpoint; Robert works to convince Don that running a restaurant takes a village.

title: Restaurant: Impossible
description: Robert Irvine heads to Smith's Soul Food Bistro in Gastonia, N.C.; owner Cheryl is an ex-basketball coach on a mission to help kids in her community; Robert must teach Cheryl to run her restaurant with the same discipline she learned on the court.

title: Restaurant: Impossible
description: Robert Irvine visits Brunswick, Ga., where two best friends have no idea how to run their restaurant, Moondoggy's Pizza; with their friendship and restaurant on the line, he teaches them how to build a better culture among their staff.

title: Restaurant: Impossible
description: In Stone Mountain, Ga., Robert Irvine visits the failing Sweet Potato Café, which is harming its owners' finances and their 25-year marriage; he must help them balance responsibilities and rekindle their passion for the business.

title: Candified: Home for the Holidays
description: With more than half of the house to finish, Jackie tackles the living room of their life-sized candy house; an unexpected visit from their investor raises tensions amongst the team, and Jackie must find a way to bring everyone back together.

title: Tournament of Champions: All-Star Christmas
description: Guy Fieri continues the holiday festivities with the last three first-round battles; TOC champ Mei Lin and pastry wiz Alex Stupak battle the wild and crazy duo of chefs Brian Malarkey and Carlos Anthony.

title: Tournament of Champions: All-Star Christmas
description: Guy Fieri welcomes the victorious Great 8 teams back for the second round, but with the randomizer dialed to extra naughty, only three teams will move one step closer to the trophy, $100,000, and major charity cash.
